We use generative AI in a limited capacity to extend backgrounds (canvas expansion) and remove unwanted elements in some of the live-action miniature images.

The original source materials are real photographs, and all content is reviewed and adjusted by the developer.

Generative AI is also used as a writing assistant for parts of the in-game text.
